summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks if lower castes can attain Brahmana status; Bhishma replies no and begins the story of Matanga, whose birth is revealed by a speaking she‑ass.

image_candidates.scene_text: A she-ass tenderly speaks to her foal while Matanga stands shocked beside the cart he had driven harshly.
Matanga striking the young ass with a goad as the frightened animal runs toward its mother.
The she-ass confronts Matanga as he steps down from the cart, demanding to know how she knows his true birth.
